name: register_converted_video
description:
Import a finished MG→video render as a video asset in the media pool.

Step 2 of the MG→video convert flow: after convert_motion_graphic_to_video kicks the render and track_export reports status "complete", call this with the renderId to promote the render output into the media pool as a real video asset — the backend resolves the output itself, no download URL needed. Returns the video asset id (deterministic — re-running dedupes to the same asset).

After this you can place the video with edit_item (add a video item referencing the returned videoAssetId), or to replace the original MG clip delete the MG item and add a video item in the same edit_item call.

mgAssetId.description: Source motion-graphic asset id or prefix (the mgAssetId returned by convert_motion_graphic_to_video).

outputUrl.description: Raw render output URL — only as a fallback when a renderId is unavailable.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

renderId.description: The convert render id returned by convert_motion_graphic_to_video (preferred; pass it once track_export reports the render complete).
